title: kith-events make_channel capacity=0 panics instead of returning Err
description: make_channel(0) triggers assert\!(capacity > 0, ...) which panics. The assert message is useful for debugging but a panic in library code is not appropriate when the caller could receive a Result. If make_channel is called from server startup code, the panic will crash the daemon. The assert is acceptable for a private internal function but make_channel is pub. Either change the signature to return Result<(EventSender, EventReceiver), &'static str> or make it a NonZeroUsize parameter. The current test confirms the panic behavior, but 'confirmed panic' \!= 'correct API'.
